about:
Metropolitan Parts, Inc. operates from Hartleton, Pennsylvania, where it was founded in 1998 as a specialist supplier for the Nash Metropolitan. The company began with a focus on providing quality parts and restoration services for the compact car produced from 1954 to 1962.

The business maintains an inventory of over 1,000 parts covering brake, fuel, interior, electrical, engine, exterior, suspension, transmission, cooling, and exhaust systems. It runs a full restoration facility and offers a proprietary Bull Dawg line of parts manufactured to its specifications. The company also supplies original factory service manuals and provides technical support for owners and restorers.

Customers include individual Metropolitan owners, restoration shops, and collectors across the United States and internationally. The company notes free shipping for U.S. military personnel on online orders and serves a global clientele through its e-commerce site.

The founders' personal ownership of a 1956 Metropolitan drives their emphasis on fit and function; they state that hands-on experience with the vehicle allows them to verify that parts meet demanding quality standards before they are offered for sale.
